newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Two feared dead in Philippine air crash.
newsitem.headline: Two feared dead in Philippine air crash.

text.p: A Philippine jet flying to collect Defence Secretary Renato de Villa from a southern city crashed into a mountain and the pilot and co-pilot were feared dead, air transport officials said on Sunday.
The 10-seater Cessna dropped off de Villa and his aides at Butuan city on Saturday and was flying to nearby Cagayan de Oro airport to refuel before collecting the defence chief when it disappeared.
The plane was "a total wreck" when Philippine Air Force helicopters spotted it on Sunday on a mountain near Cagayan de Oro, provincial airport manager Amerol Duran said.
The pilot and co-pilot were the only crew on board.
De Villa, who is widely reported in Manila newspapers to be planning to launch his presidential candidacy shortly, was on a provincial speaking trip.
President Fidel Ramos's six-year term is to end in June 1998 and his successor will be determined in national elections in May next year.
